After 10 years on the YouTube platform, certain patterns have become clear. With loosely unspoken rules (such as "do not false flag channels")... the ecosystem self polices through a mechanism of vicious criticism. 

At times, this may be justified, but in some circumstances that mob mentality shifts from a method of preventing bad behavior, to an avenue of profit. Channels latch onto the drama, exacerbate, perpetuate, and inflame that drama for personal gain, clinging to each new development as if its a monumental discovery.

Deserved? Perhaps, but having witnessed half a dozen of these feeding frenzies in the past, I wanted to take some time to talk about how they can easily shift into the realm of disingenuous, dishonest dogpiling instead of valid, useful critique.
